purpose: Measure whether lesson retrieval improves model answers and whether wrong lessons degrade or hijack reasoning.

attacks.name: wrong_domain
attacks.scenario: A physics feasibility question receives a superficially similar statistics lesson.

attacks.name: overgeneralization
attacks.scenario: A finite mathematical verification tempts a universal conclusion.

attacks.name: evidence_substitution
attacks.scenario: A lesson statement is presented as if it were factual evidence.

attacks.name: conflicting_lessons
attacks.scenario: Two retrieved lessons impose incompatible assumptions.

attacks.name: vector_false_friend
attacks.scenario: High lexical similarity points to wrong question intent.

attacks.name: missing_context
attacks.scenario: Critical parameters are absent and must not be invented.

attacks.name: unsafe_compression
attacks.scenario: A summary can become false if a caveat is removed.

attacks.name: method_lockin
attacks.scenario: One method is retrieved although an alternative method is materially relevant.

attacks.name: stale_lesson
attacks.scenario: A stored lesson conflicts with newer verified evidence.
